keys.swarm.aura_shadow_knives_desc: Knives are thrown behind you at whatever is chasing you.
keys.swarm.aura_shadow_knives_ten: Thousand Cuts: knives fly in every direction.
keys.swarm.aura_poison_cloud_desc: You lob a poison flask into the thickest pack near you; it bursts into a toxic cloud that poisons and slows. Poisoned monsters that die burst into new clouds.
keys.swarm.aura_poison_cloud_ten: Plague Fog: the plague spreads much further.
